decisions.decision: A Couranr review outcome sets review_state AND fires one explicit guarded transition on request_state. Confirm-as-quoted is PAYER-DEPENDENT: a merchant-paid request goes straight to confirmed because the merchant already approved the exact displayed quote at submission; a customer-paid request waits on the customer.

preconditions.atomicity: request mutation and event insert in one transaction

outcomes.rationale: The merchant approved the exact displayed quote when submitting. Operations confirmed it without changing the price, so a second merchant approval would be redundant.
outcomes.additional_guard: the immutable submission event must carry acknowledgment = true, and the current quote must be the submitted, unrevised quote

outcomes.rationale: The merchant cannot approve a customer-paid quote on the customer's behalf. The customer must still review and approve the price.

transitions.guard: a server-computed quote exists; the caller supplies no amount
subtotal recomputed server-side through the canonical pricing engine; line items must sum to it
transitions.rationale: A changed quote always requires fresh approval from the payer, for either payer type.

transitions.guard: a structured decline reason is required; an internal note is optional

onward_transitions_not_in_this_decision.awaiting_quote_acceptance: -> confirmed when the payer approves; -> cancelled if declined or expired
onward_transitions_not_in_this_decision.quote_revision_required: -> confirmed when the payer approves the revised quote; -> cancelled if declined or expired
onward_transitions_not_in_this_decision.note: Owned by the payment slice. No payment authorization or capture is performed by a review command.

decisions.decision: The canonical vocabulary of reasons Couranr could not confirm a delivery is couranr-decline-v1: eight codes, each with owner-approved merchant-safe copy. The merchant message is derived server-side from the code and is never supplied by a caller. `other` and `merchant_account_on_hold` require a non-empty internal note. Internal notes are never returned to a merchant or customer view.

merchant_messages.outside_service_area: Couranr could not confirm service for this route.
merchant_messages.requested_time_unavailable: Couranr could not confirm the requested delivery time.
merchant_messages.no_driver_available: Couranr does not have an available driver for this request.
merchant_messages.no_compatible_vehicle: Couranr could not confirm a compatible vehicle for this shipment.
merchant_messages.shipment_not_supported: This shipment cannot be handled through Couranr.
merchant_messages.merchant_account_on_hold: This business account needs attention before Couranr can confirm service.
merchant_messages.duplicate_or_superseded: This request was replaced by another request.
merchant_messages.other: Couranr could not confirm this request. Contact Couranr Support for details.

Section 15's instruction to disable /api/delivery/mark-in-transit applied to its unsafe unauthenticated implementation, which accepted a deliveryId from an unauthenticated body and wrote status with the service-role key.
